actions.title: x_account_brief
actions.description: Research a list of public X accounts before posting about or tagging them, with no login. For each account: its own account statistics worded as things you could say (followers, best post versus typical post, views), the figures it has posted about itself (money, percentages, multiples, counts like "1.2M transactions") quoted in context with a link to the source post, its posts about a topic, its recent posts, and who it tags, reposts and links to. Across the list: a ready-to-paste tag line, and accounts that several listed accounts mention but that are not on the list yet. Returns Markdown by default, suited to drafting posts from; pass format "json" for the structured data. Cached for six hours, so calling again with one more account only fetches the new one.

actions.title: x_account_report
actions.description: Full account report for one or more public X accounts, computed from public data with no login: engagement rate, median interactions per post, posting cadence, content mix (original vs reply vs repost, media and link share), best hour and weekday by median engagement, top posts, top hashtags, and plain-language observations. Pass an array of usernames to get a side-by-side comparison as well. Use this instead of fetching a profile and a timeline separately when the question is about how an account is performing.

actions.title: x_action_budget
actions.description: Report the remaining daily action budget for the active account: for each action class (post, reply, like, repost, follow, unfollow, dm, block, mute, delete) the cap, how many actions were used in the rolling 24 hour window, how many remain, and when the next slot frees. Caps persist across restarts and are set by XACTIONS_ACTION_CAPS or ~/.xactions/action-caps.json.

actions.title: x_analyze_sentiment
actions.description: Analyze the sentiment of text. Returns a score (-1 to 1), label (positive/neutral/negative), confidence, and key sentiment-bearing words. Uses a built-in rule-based analyzer by default (zero dependencies), or optionally an LLM via OpenRouter for nuanced analysis.

actions.title: x_analyze_voice
actions.description: Analyze a user's writing style/voice from their tweets. Returns tone, vocabulary patterns, emoji usage, avg length, and a voice profile.

actions.title: x_api_describe
actions.description: Everything needed to call one official X API v2 operation: parameters with types, allowed values and ranges, the request body properties, which credentials and OAuth 2.0 scopes it accepts, its published rate limits, and the official reference page. Needs no keys.

actions.title: x_api_get
actions.description: Call a read (GET) operation of the official X API v2 with the configured developer credentials (X_BEARER_TOKEN, OAuth 1.0a keys, or an OAuth 2.0 user token from `xactions xapi auth login`). Parameters are validated against the catalog before any request. Set all: true to follow pagination. Returns data, includes, meta, errors and the rate-limit state.

actions.title: x_api_list_operations
actions.description: Search the catalog of every official X API v2 operation (generated from X's published OpenAPI document). Returns operation ids, routes, accepted credentials and the official reference link. Use it to find the id to pass to x_api_describe, x_api_get or x_api_write. Needs no keys.

actions.title: x_api_stream_sample
actions.description: Open a streaming operation of the official X API v2 (filtered stream, sample stream, firehose, activity stream) and return the first messages, then close it. Bounded by a message count and a time limit. Needs app or user credentials the operation accepts.

actions.title: x_api_write
actions.description: Call an operation of the official X API v2 that changes state (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE): create or delete posts, like, repost, follow, block, mute, send DMs, manage lists, bookmarks, webhooks and more. Uses the configured user credentials. Held as a draft when approval is required, and charged against the daily action caps by what the operation does. Pass dryRun: true to see the exact request first.

actions.title: x_approve_draft
actions.description: Approve a pending draft and execute the stored tool call exactly as it was submitted. Only offered when approval mode is off (drafts left from an earlier session); with approval mode on, a person approves with `xactions drafts approve <id>`. A draft that already ran is refused so nothing is posted twice.

actions.title: Post Composer
actions.description: Compose and post a tweet, a reply, a thread or a poll from your logged-in session, with a dry run by default.

actions.title: Post Interactions
actions.description: Post interaction tools: like, repost, bookmark, share, mute and report a post.

actions.title: Post Thread
actions.description: Compose and post a thread of connected tweets in one pass, with length checks and a dry run by default.

actions.title: Premium Gifting
actions.description: Open the flow for gifting Premium to another account.

actions.title: Premium Manager
actions.description: Detect your X Premium tier from on-page signals, list its features and what the next tier adds, and export the result.

actions.title: Profile Stats
actions.description: Comprehensive statistics for any profile.

actions.title: Protect Active Users
actions.description: Scan your recent posts for likers, repliers, reposters and quoters and save them as a protected list that smart unfollow never touches.

actions.title: QR Code Profile Sharing
actions.description: Generate a shareable QR code for any X profile, shown in an overlay and downloadable as a PNG.

actions.title: Quota Supervisor
actions.description: Watch the action quotas of running automations and pause them before X limits the account.

actions.title: Quote Post
actions.description: Quote the post you are viewing with your own text.

actions.title: Quote Tweet Automation
actions.description: Quote-post tweets from a timeline or search with rotating templates, keyword and engagement filters, a dry run and long delays.

actions.title: Rate Limiter
actions.description: Rate limiting and quota helper shared by the action scripts.

actions.title: Remove Followers
actions.description: Remove specific, all or low-quality followers with X's native Remove this follower, with an optional soft-block fallback.

actions.title: Report Spam
actions.description: Report a list of spam or bot accounts, or scan a user list for spam signals and report the matches, dry run by default.

actions.title: Repost Posts
actions.description: Repost specific posts by URL, or the posts on screen that match keywords.

actions.title: Reputation Audit
actions.description: AI-score your own posts for professional, hostile, legal and spam risk, then optionally delete what was flagged.

actions.title: Save Search
actions.description: Save the current search query, list saved searches, or delete one.

actions.title: Saved Search Manager
actions.description: Save, list, run and delete saved searches.

actions.title: Schedule Posts
actions.description: Queue one or more posts in X's native scheduler, setting each date and time in the Schedule dialog, dry run by default.

actions.title: Scrape Analytics
actions.description: Scrape account and post analytics: impressions, engagement rates and audience.

actions.title: Scrape Cashtag Search
actions.description: Scrape cashtag search results with sentiment, for stock and crypto ticker mentions.

actions.title: Scrape DMs
actions.description: Export the open DM conversation (sender, text, timestamp, direction) as JSON, CSV or text, or list your inbox conversations.

actions.title: Scrape Explore
actions.description: Scrape trending topics, search results, or the Explore page's trends and posts, and export them as JSON.

actions.title: Scrape Followers
actions.description: Scroll the followers list of any profile and export every follower (handle, name, bio, verified, follows-you) to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Scrape Following
actions.description: Scroll the following list of any profile and export everyone it follows (handle, name, bio, verified, follows-you) to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Scrape Hashtag
actions.description: Scroll a hashtag's live results and export every post (text, author, counts, media) to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Scrape Likers
actions.description: Scroll the Likes view of a post and export every user who liked it (handle, name, bio, verified, follows-you) to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Scrape Likes
actions.description: Scroll a user's Likes timeline and export the posts they liked (url, author, text, counts) to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Scrape List
actions.description: Export an X List's timeline posts, or its members, to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Scrape Media
actions.description: Collect every image, video and GIF URL from a profile's Media tab and export them as JSON, CSV and a URL list.

actions.title: Scrape Notifications
actions.description: Export your notifications feed (type, actor handles, text, timestamp) to JSON and CSV, with a breakdown by type and top interactors.

actions.title: Scrape Profile
actions.description: Read a profile's name, bio, location, website, join date, counts, verified badge and images, and download them as JSON.

actions.title: Scrape Profile Posts
actions.description: Scrape every post from a profile with filters, analytics and JSON, CSV and Markdown exports.

actions.title: Scrape Profile With Replies
actions.description: Scrape a profile's posts from the With replies tab, then open each post and collect the replies other users left, with JSON, CSV, Markdown, text and HTML export.

actions.title: Scrape Replies
actions.description: Scroll the conversation under an open post and export every reply (author, text, counts) to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Scrape Reposters and Quotes
actions.description: Scroll a post's Reposts and Quotes tabs and export everyone who reposted or quote-tweeted it, each tagged repost or quote, to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Scrape Search
actions.description: Scroll the current X search results and export every post (text, author, counts, media) to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Scrape Spaces
actions.description: List the Spaces on a profile, search or timeline (live, scheduled, ended), or capture the open Space's title, host, listeners and speakers.

actions.title: Scraper Toolbox
actions.description: On-page scraping control panel with start, pause and stop, live filters and one-click exports.

actions.title: Search Sweep
actions.description: Delete, like, repost or reply to every post an X search returns.

actions.title: Send Direct Messages
actions.description: Send a personalized DM to each user in a list, with a per-session cap, long delays, sent-history skipping and a dry run by default.

actions.title: Sentiment Analyzer
actions.description: Score the sentiment of posts on any timeline, search or profile with a weighted lexicon, and report the distribution, extremes, emotional words and toxicity.

actions.title: Session Logger
actions.description: Log what the automation scripts did in a session and export the analytics.

actions.title: Settings Manager
actions.description: Export and audit the settings pages and toggle states on x.com/settings, or toggle protected posts, dry run by default.

actions.title: Shadowban Checker
actions.description: Run heuristic shadowban checks (suggestion ban, search ban, ghost ban, media visibility) for your account or any handle.

actions.title: Share and Embed Posts
actions.description: Copy post links and embed codes, one post or in bulk.

actions.title: Smart Unfollow
actions.description: Unfollow accounts that did not follow you back within a grace period, with a whitelist, a dry run and a cap.

actions.title: Subscribe to Premium
actions.description: Open the Premium subscription page and show the plans.

actions.title: Text Formatting
actions.description: Format post text with Unicode bold, italic and other styles.

actions.title: Thought Leader Cultivator
actions.description: Train the algorithm for your niche by simulating natural browsing: read, like and bookmark.

actions.title: Thread Composer
actions.description: Compose, preview and publish a multi-post thread with character counts, numbering, saved drafts and a dry run by default.

actions.title: Thread Unroller
actions.description: Collect every post the author wrote in a thread and save it as markdown, plain text or JSON.

actions.title: Timeline Scraper
actions.description: Scrape posts from the home timeline and other feeds.

actions.title: Timeline Viewer
actions.description: Switch between the For you and Following timelines and collect the posts shown.

actions.title: Topic Manager
actions.description: Browse, follow and unfollow Topics.

actions.title: Trending Topic Monitor
actions.description: Capture the current trends with post counts and niches, flag watched keywords, compare against past snapshots and optionally re-scan on an interval.

actions.title: Tweet A/B Tester
actions.description: Track the engagement of two posted tweet variants over time and pick a winner, with tests saved in localStorage.

actions.title: Tweet Performance Comparator
actions.description: Rank your recent posts by engagement, rate and views, and break down what performs by media, content type, length, hashtags and hour.

actions.title: Post and Price Correlation
actions.description: Correlate how often an account posts with token or stock price movements.

actions.title: Tweet Schedule Optimizer
actions.description: Score your past posts by day and hour, weighting engagement, replies and reposts, and build a personalized weekly posting schedule.

actions.title: Unfollow Everyone
actions.description: Unfollow every account you follow, with a whitelist, a cap, a start confirmation and a JSON export.

actions.title: Unfollow Non-Followers With Log
actions.description: Unfollow accounts that don't follow you back and download a JSON, CSV or text log of every account, with a dry run and a whitelist.

actions.title: Unfollow Non-Followers
actions.description: Unfollow accounts that do not follow you back, with a whitelist, a dry run, rate-limit cooldowns and a JSON export.

actions.title: Unlike All Posts
actions.description: Unlike the posts in your Likes tab, with keyword filters, a cap, a confirmation and a dry run by default.

actions.title: Unlike Old Likes
actions.description: Remove likes older than a number of days you set.

actions.title: Update Banner
actions.description: Guided helper for changing your profile banner.

actions.title: Update Profile
actions.description: Update your display name, bio, location, website and birthdate in the Edit profile form, dry run by default.

actions.title: Update Profile Picture
actions.description: Guided helper for changing your profile picture.

actions.title: Upload Contacts
actions.description: Open the contact upload page, start a contact upload, or disconnect synced contacts.

actions.title: Verified-Only Replies
actions.description: Set who can reply to a new post to verified accounts only.

actions.title: Video Captions
actions.description: Upload caption files to your videos.

actions.title: Video Downloader
actions.description: Find every video or GIF URL on a post, pick a quality and download it, with batch and metadata helpers.

actions.title: View Analytics
actions.description: Open the analytics pages and scrape overview and per-post metrics (Premium).

actions.title: Viral Tweet Detector
actions.description: Scan a timeline or search and rank posts going viral by engagement rate and velocity (engagement per hour), with a JSON export.

actions.title: Viral Tweets Scraper
actions.description: Find the top-performing posts on a search or profile by like, repost and reply thresholds, sorted and exported to JSON and CSV.

actions.title: Vote in Polls
actions.description: Vote in the polls in a timeline or search as it scrolls, with a fixed or random option.

actions.title: Welcome New Followers
actions.description: Detect followers who are new since the last run and draft a personalized welcome DM for each, with a dry run, a cap and long delays.

actions.title: Whitelist Manager
actions.description: Keep a list of users the other automation scripts never act on.

actions.title: X Pro
actions.description: Open X Pro (TweetDeck) and add search columns.

actions.title: X Pro Manager
actions.description: X Pro (TweetDeck) automation: decks, columns and layouts.
